english.title: Knowingly / recklessly make false statement regarding baggage / cargo / stores carried by sea or port security
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without lawful authority or reasonable excuse, made a statement, namely **(..SPECIFY STATEMENT..), knowing it to be or being reckless as to whether it was, false in a material particular, in answer to a question put to you by

(A)_[a constable,]_
(B)_[an officer of the UK Border Agency,]_
(C)_[a port security officer,]_
(D)_[a person acting on behalf of a port security officer,]_
(E)_[a port facility security officer,]_
(F)_[a person acting on behalf of a port facility security officer,]_
(G)_[a directed party,]_
(H)_[a person acting on behalf of a directed party,]_
(I)_[a security manager,]_
(J)_[a person acting on behalf of a security manager,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY CONSTABLE / OFFICER / PERSON..), for purposes to which the Port Security Regulations 2009 apply, that related to baggage, cargo or stores, intended for carriage by sea by a United Kingdom ship or by another ship to or from the United Kingdom
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 31 of the Port Security Regulations 2009.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
without lawful authority / reasonable excuse
made a statement known to be false in a material particular OR
recklessly made a statement which was false in a material particular
in answer to a question
relating to baggage / cargo / stores intended for carriage by sea by a UK ship or by any other ship to / from the UK OR
asked by a constable / officer of UKBA / executive agency of Home Office / port security officer / port facility security officer / directed part / security manager for purposes to which the Port Security Regulations 2009 apply

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Regulation 36 creates a defence of due diligence in relation to this offence; in any proceedings against any person for an offence under the Regulations it is a defence for that person to show that they took all reasonable steps and exercised all due diligence to avoid committing the offence.

other.penalty:
Summary: Level 5 fine.

Note
On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed - as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
